name: SACDExtractGUI
description:
SACDExtractGUI is a user-friendly graphical interface for sacd_extract. It simplifies extracting high-resolution DSD audio files (DFF, DSF) and audio tracks from Super Audio CD (SACD) ISO images and network players.

Features:
- Extracts high-resolution stereo and multi-channel DSD audio streams
- Supports converting SACD ISO disc images directly to DSF and DFF track files
- Preserves album art, track numbers, performers, and title metadata
- Batch processing queue for ripping entire collections of SACD images
- Clean graphical interface with real-time extraction progress meters
